entity.name: Sami Halawa Ribas
entity.description: Independent AI engineer based in Madrid, Spain. I build and maintain open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that give AI agents real capabilities, such as email and browser-based visual testing.

projects.name: email-smtp-imap-mcp
projects.description: Multi-account email server for AI agents over the Model Context Protocol: SMTP sending, IMAP search, replies, attachments and inbox organisation, usable from any MCP client. Published on npm (about 3,200 downloads in the last 12 months), MIT licence.

projects.name: VUDA: Visual UI Debug Agent MCP
projects.description: Model Context Protocol server that gives AI agents a real browser for testing and debugging web interfaces with Playwright: screenshots, DOM and style inspection, multi-step workflow validation, console capture, API checks and visual diffs. 29 MCP tools; runs locally or against any CDP browser. Published on npm, ISC licence.

channels.description: International bank transfer (SEPA or SWIFT) to the maintainer's bank account in Spain. Account details are provided on request.

plans.name: Ongoing maintenance
plans.description: Funds maintainer time to keep both MCP servers working as the MCP specification, SDKs and client applications change: compatibility updates, bug fixes, reviewing issues and contributions, documentation, tests in CI and regular releases on npm.
